text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: "Hmm, that was so close. Don't let it get you down, Trainer-san!"

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
It's quite all right, I can still sense
its cuteness just watching from here.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Ah, but... you were getting the hang of it toward the end, weren't you?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"Then maybe next time
we can get tons in both hands?
Fufu, I'm getting excited just thinking about it."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It ended in a disappointing result...
